title: Maximum value of a decreasing linear function on a closed interval
source: Theory P1-2.1 Quick check 1 (maximum of 5-2x on -4<=x<=5 is 13); book Worked example 2.1 style, new numbers
stem: The function \(f\) is given by \(f(x)={k|int}-{m|int}x\) for \({a|int}\leqslant x\leqslant {b|int}\). What is the maximum value of \(f\)?

steps.name: A
steps.text_tex: The gradient is negative, so the maximum is at the left endpoint: \(f({a|int})={k|int}-{m|int}({a|int})={M|int}\).

title: Evaluate a linear function at a given input
source: Theory P1-2.1 Quick check 2 (f(x)=x+2, f(5)=7); book function-notation example on printed p.35, new numbers
stem: If \(f(x)=x+{c|int}\), what is the value of \(f({n|int})\)?

steps.name: A
steps.note: V is n plus c. Original: 5+2=7.

title: Minimum value of a translated square on an interval containing the turning point
source: Theory P1-2.1 Quick check 3 (minimum of (x-3)^2+8 on -1<=x<=9 is 8); book Worked example 2.2 style, new numbers
stem: The function \(f\) is defined by \(f(x)=(x-{h|int})^2+{k|int}\) for \({a|int}\leqslant x\leqslant {b|int}\). What is the minimum value of \(f\)?

steps.name: A
steps.text_tex: The squared bracket is zero when \(x={h|int}\), which lies inside the domain, so the minimum value is \({k|int}\).
steps.note: The turning point x=h is required to lie in [a,b] by the constraints.

title: Completed-square form and the range of a restricted quadratic

source.note: Stem taken from the QP PDF (UCLES 2022), Question 2(a) and (b) only. Official answers and mark allocation from the MS PDF. The item is paper/self-mark. Part 2(c), which asks for the inverse, is omitted.

stem:
This question is 9709/13/O/N/22 Question 2(a) and (b), taken from the official QP.

The function \(f\) is defined by \(f(x)=-2x^2-8x-13\) for \(x\lt -3\).

(a) Express \(f(x)\) in the form \(-2(x+a)^2+b\), where \(a\) and \(b\) are integers.  [2]

(b) Find the range of \(f\).  [1]

steps.name: B1
steps.note: MS 2(a): B1 B1 for -2(x+2)^2 and for -5 (the completed-square constants a=2 and b=-5).

steps.name: B2
steps.note: MS 2(a): the completed form is -2(x+2)^2-5. Independent check: expand to -2x^2-8x-8-5=-2x^2-8x-13.

steps.name: A
steps.text_tex: The graph is a downward-opening parabola. On the given domain \(x\lt -3\), which lies to the left of \(x=-2\), the values of \(f\) are less than \(f(-3)=-7\). The range of the function is therefore \(f(x)\lt -7\).
steps.note: MS 2(b): f(x) < -7, or equivalent such as y < -7 or (-infinity, -7). Independent: f(-3)=-7 is not attained, and as x tends to minus infinity, f tends to minus infinity.
